## Vocabulary Matching (9 points)
For each definition, select the correct word or phrase. Each correct match is worth 1 point.
**2.** Select the word or phrase for each definition. (3 points)
Write the letter of the matching option.
| 1. short of something that is needed | ____ | A. evenhanded |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2. very fierce, aggressive, or violent | ____ | B. ferocious |
| 3. fair to both sides in a disagreement | ____ | C. deficient |
Correct answer: <i>1–C, 2–B, 3–A</i>
